core_obligations: Get full faithfulness from the equivalence proposition, and commutation with colimits, hence with direct sums and right exactness, by recognizing the construction as pullback along a morphism of ringed sites (proof lines 3309-3327).
Get exactness for the small etale site from flatness of etale morphisms (proof lines 3329-3335).

Produce two counterexamples over the spectrum of the integers: multiplication by two is injective as a map of quasi-coherent modules but not after passing to the big site, and the internal hom of the cokernel of that map against the structure sheaf is a nonzero torsion module on the big site while the corresponding internal hom of quasi-coherent modules vanishes (proof lines 3337-3342 and 3364-3375).
Get compatibility with tensor products and, for etale and Zariski in the small case, with internal hom from the pullback descriptions and flatness (proof lines 3344-3362).

Prove the last part: restrict the short exact sequence to the small site, use the vanishing of the first cohomology of the associated module on affines to obtain right exactness there, then show the map on sections is universally injective by testing against square-zero algebras, which gives the commutativity of the comparison diagram and hence quasi-coherence of the middle term (proof lines 3377-3423).
proof_roadmap: Full faithfulness, colimits and right exactness (proof lines 3309-3327).
Exactness on the small etale site (proof lines 3329-3335).
Tensor and internal hom compatibility (proof lines 3344-3362).
The last part by universal injectivity (proof lines 3377-3423).
difficulty_reason: For a topology tau among Zariski, etale, smooth, syntomic and fppf, the lemma collects ten properties of the functors sending a quasi-coherent module to the associated module on the big and on the small tau-site: full faithfulness, commutation with direct sums and colimits, right exactness, exactness for the small etale site, failure of exactness for the big site in general, compatibility with tensor products, compatibility with internal hom for etale and Zariski in the small case, failure of that compatibility in the big case, and quasi-coherence of the middle term of a short exact sequence between associated modules (statement lines 3255-3307). The proof is a genuine assembly: colimit compatibility comes from recognizing the construction as a pullback of ringed sites, left exactness for the small etale site from flatness of etale morphisms, and the two failures are established by explicit counterexamples over the spectrum of the integers, where multiplication by two is injective but not so on the big site, and where the internal hom of a cokernel is a nonzero torsion sheaf on one side and zero on the other (proof lines 3309-3375). The most substantial part is the last one, which reduces to affine opens, uses the vanishing of the first cohomology of the associated module to get right exactness on the small site, and then proves universal injectivity of the map on sections by testing against square-zero algebras (proof lines 3377-3423). The claim is H3: two independent counterexample constructions and a genuinely original reduction in the last part, none of which is a citation chain.
